soundness_flags.label: ass:qv-growth
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Saco condition is pointwise variance growth for an iid-arrival sequence, not the stated uniform-over-finite-population-arrays lower bound, so this cannot remain tagged standard with that citation.

soundness_flags.label: Theorems 5 and 6 / def:admissible-arrays
soundness_flags.one_line: The class contains only pointwise asymptotic conditions with array-specific overlap, moments, count-growth, and leverage rates, yet both statements take a supremum or infimum over all arrays; no uniform class or common deterministic rate is defined.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 8
soundness_flags.one_line: “Largest root-to-leaf weighted integrality gap” and the class of permitted fixed-fraction reductions of U_n are not defined, so the compatibility and coverage-sharpness questions lack a single mathematical target.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1 / technical_internal_limitation
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exactness is claimed only in the nodewise rectangular convexified relaxation, not for a single ex ante fixed-potential-outcome completion across all history nodes.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The headline is an exact predictable rectangular-relaxation envelope claim; deterministic global-completion sharpness remains only Open-ended Question 8.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes design-based IPW/AIPW theory for general adaptive designs in a finite-population framework and introduces a covariance estimator that is sharp under additive adaptive-regression residuals.
The paper casts causal partial identification with K potential-outcome margins as MOT, obtains an exact identified set, and develops plug-in MOT rates for quadratic objectives.

The journal article concerns consistent estimation of sharp variance bounds for the difference-in-means estimator under complete randomization and the resulting narrowest asymptotically conservative Wald interval.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2401.16667; published Statistics in Medicine 44, 2025, e70139
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies design-based sharp variance estimation and causal bootstrap for weighted difference-in-means estimators in stratified randomized experiments.
The paper extends Aronow--Green--Lee-style asymptotically sharp variance bounds to general regression adjustment in randomized experiments.
The paper characterizes sharp identified-set endpoints by optimal-transport values and develops sample-analogue estimators with distributional convergence and bootstrap inference.

Assumption 5.11 is the pointwise iid-arrival condition Pr(V_T^2 >= v_- n_eff) -> 1, and Theorem 5.14 proves realized-QV studentized inference without deterministic variance stabilization. It does not state uniformity over a class of finite-population triangular arrays.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association, published online 13 May 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article characterizes admissible conservative variance bounds in a quadratic-form class for interference and complex designs and frames their construction as an optimization problem.
The study used 12 minitrials and four contextual-bandit arms; subsequent allocation was adaptive and the paper explicitly states that there was no minimum or maximum allocation to trial arms.
